title: Never-show list (one JSON file at profile.paths.never_show), /frontend's format
description: Exact mirror of /frontend's assets/schemas/never-show.schema.json (its CONTRACTS.md 6.1b), which is canonical: note optional, the same id pattern, a non-blank source, and an embargo always carries a until_utc string. The only keyword left out is `format` (outside our validator's subset): nevershow.load compiles every regex entry itself and parses until_utc as an ISO instant ending in Z. execlib.nevershow validates against BOTH when /frontend's file exists and reports W_NEVER_SHOW_SCHEMA_DRIFT if they disagree on a document. Semantics: an entry whose until_utc is in the past is inactive; /execution scans scope repo|both (added lines and new commit messages of every merge, the tracked tree, and the whole history before the public flip); /frontend scans rendered text (scope rendered|both). regex false = literal substring; case_sensitive false = case-folded (NFKC + casefold) on both sides.

allOf.description: An embargo has an end date.
